questions.stem: Convert 2.5 m squared to cm squared.
questions.explanation: 1 m squared = 10,000 cm squared (because 1 m = 100 cm, so 1 m^2 = 100^2 = 10,000 cm^2). Therefore 2.5 m squared = 2.5 x 10,000 = 25,000 cm squared. Multiplying by 100 instead of 10,000 is a common error.

questions.stem: A fish tank has a volume of 0.06 m cubed. How many litres is this?
questions.explanation: 1 m cubed = 1000 litres. So 0.06 m cubed = 0.06 x 1000 = 60 litres.

questions.stem: Convert 45,000 cm squared to m squared.
A cylindrical container has a volume of 5000 cm cubed. What is this in ml?
questions.explanation: 1 ml = 1 cm cubed. So 5000 cm cubed = 5000 ml.

questions.stem: A room is 4.5 m long and 3.2 m wide. How many square centimetres is this?
questions.explanation: Area = 4.5 x 3.2 = 14.4 m squared. Convert: 14.4 x 10,000 = 144,000 cm squared. Alternatively: 450 cm x 320 cm = 144,000 cm squared.
